fields.description: Comma-separated fields as key:type — "!" marks required, selects take options: "name!:string,price:currency,status:select=draft|published,createdAt:date". Types: string, textarea, email, url, number, currency, boolean, date, datetime, select, tags.

plural.description: Plural override when the naive pluralizer guesses wrong (e.g. --plural people).

api.description: REST base URL (e.g. /api/products). Set: the service uses HttpClient; unset: an in-memory store that runs immediately.

path.description: Directory the entity folder is created in. Default: the application's src/app.

project.description: Workspace project to target. Default: the first application project.

route.description: Wire a lazy route into the application's app.routes.ts.

spec.description: Generate a harness-driven spec for the pages.
